M.S. Candidate in Data Science • Seoul National University

Jaeseong Ju

I am an M.S. candidate at Seoul National University, focusing on HCI, especially Human-AI Interaction (HAI).
I investigate how LLM and data science methods can be used in ways that are trustworthy, ethical, and socially valuable.

About

My research focuses on Human-AI Interaction (HAI), with a specific interest in how people can effectively and safely use AI systems such as large language models (LLMs) in real-world domains. I design LLM- and visualization-based tools that make AI-powered analysis and decision-making more accessible and trustworthy across diverse contexts.
